race.comment: POLYMER (3) started in the red but failed to deliver when fresh from a spell last start over 1100m at this track, finishing out of the placings and never looking likely. Has a perfect second and third-up record, both of those wins coming here at this distance. Can bounce back. CALYPSO ROCKET (1) is back after a four-month spell. Started favourite in a Rosehill Highway at the beginning of last prep but disappointed. Saves his best for 1200m at this circuit so a big run will not surprise. MYALABY (10) gets back in her races which makes life tough and explains the poor win percentage. Has generally been about the money in her four runs this prep. Drawn to need luck at some stage but has the talent to put these to the test. WISHFUL THINKER (5) draws another double-digit barrier. Crossed and led last time here at this trip but wilted late under 60.5 kg. Tries hard and is worth an each-way investment. Last start Coffs Harbour winner COCO DREAMING (6) is up in grade but is in the mix.
